source_mapping.physical_identity: Exact containers BOX ID/code or item_instances ID with one ACTIVE physical_codes ITEM QR/BARCODE assignment; not SKU/compatibility item_code.
source_mapping.warehouse_ownership: Exactly one persisted ACTIVE warehouse plus confirmed session and actual warehouse grants; registry membership labeled separately from physical placement.
source_mapping.placement: Latest unambiguously timed CONFIRMED putaway_events, matching box_container_id/container_id, current BOX.parent_container_id and to_tray_id/to_parent_container_id, same warehouse and a POSTED receipt.
source_mapping.location_code: Actual TRAY containers.container_code only, not a fake shelf/bin. STORED and PARTIAL BOX content statuses may retain this placement.
source_mapping.effective_time: putaway_events.confirmed_at via document-timestamps-v1, RFC3339 UTC Z; observation time is separate.
source_mapping.version_or_read_consistency: Persisted event.version and actual BOX/TRAY versions plus P06 single-response snapshot.
source_mapping.item_inherits_box_location: Exact active ITEM-mode container_items (item_id nonnull, sku_id and quantity null) + item.container_id + IN_STOCK + matching SKU. Never inherit by shared SKU.

authorization.common: Actual active sku.view grant, authenticated live session and confirmed warehouse/context; no role-name bypass.
authorization.placement: putaway.view OR putaway.manage; otherwise omit current_location with REDACTED_PERMISSION.
authorization.tenant_scope: Trusted actor/warehouse dimensions filter every source when present. No dimensions requires a single-tenant database. Unresolved source tenancy fails closed.
authorization.optional_actor_masking: No audit actor or customer PII exposed.

availability.null_policy: No null values in successful explicit-read-fields-v1 JSON.
availability.source_failure: 503 P18_LOCATION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, not NOT_RECORDED or empty success.
availability.cache_policy: private,no-store; Vary includes Authorization,Origin,both contract headers; no internal result cache.

test_scope.positive_item_dataset: NOT_RECORDED: DEV inspection found no exact active ITEM membership/current-container proof. Do not fabricate or seed one.
test_scope.credential_policy: Use the existing authorized session; no password/token/cookie in this handoff.

schema.pending_p11_migration: Retain pending; no unrestricted migrate is required for P18.
